ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_softplus_advantage_gap_weighted_mean_zscore_norm
ir.intuition: Shift aggregation from weighted sum normalized by sqrt of total weight to a weighted mean normalized by z-score of weights, preserving pairwise softplus margin with advantage_gap. Z-score normalization balances the influence of weights, reducing scale effects while incorporating variance, promoting robustness.
ir.pseudocode:
mean_weight = mean(weight)
std_weight = sqrt(var(weight) + eps)
weight_zscore = (weight - mean_weight) / std_weight
x = clamp(alpha * scale * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) + beta * advantage_gap, -20, 20)
loss = softplus(-x)
weighted_loss = loss * weight
sum_weighted_loss = sum(weighted_loss)
sum_weight = sum(weight)
agg_loss = sum_weighted_loss / sum_weight
norm_factor = 1 + abs(mean(weight_zscore))
final_loss = agg_loss / norm_factor
return final_loss
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 1.0)))
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 2.0))
    eps = 1e-12

    mean_weight = ops.mean(weight)
    variance_weight = ops.mean(ops.mul(ops.sub(weight, mean_weight), ops.sub(weight, mean_weight)))
    std_weight = ops.sqrt(ops.add(variance_weight, eps))
    weight_zscore = ops.div(ops.sub(weight, mean_weight), std_weight)

    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    x = ops.add(ops.mul(alpha * scale, diff), ops.mul(beta, advantage_gap))
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.softplus(ops.neg(x))

    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    sum_weighted_loss = ops.sum(weighted_loss)
    sum_weight = ops.sum(weight)
    agg_loss = ops.div(sum_weighted_loss, sum_weight)

    norm_factor = ops.add(ops.ones_like(mean_weight), ops.abs(ops.mean(weight_zscore)))
    final_loss = ops.div(agg_loss, norm_factor)

    return final_loss
